reviewer: Primary Codex assistant independent AI assessment
method: Read masked full sources and exact selected quotations before inspecting any case-level evaluator or independent source-agent judgment. Aggregate evaluator counts were known after the user requested status. Medium-confidence acceptance is rubric-based agreement, not human adjudication.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer joins the family visit to the ancestral village and grandfather.
assessment.value_assessment: The intergenerational visit sits within explicitly traditional household practices and supports family custom.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No writer behavior rejecting these customs is reported.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote describes the joint visit; the complete source supplies the cultural context.
assessment.evaluated_quote: we went to his parents' village with Sami to visit his grandfather

assessment.action_assessment: The writer deliberately stays silent during the lab meeting despite wanting credit.
assessment.value_assessment: Restraint of a confrontation supports smooth group interaction under the approved definition.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Private hurt is not a reported disruptive action.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote directly describes suppressing the response and remaining silent.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Sat through the whole lab meeting biting my tongue while Felix presented my preprocessing idea as his own. Didn't say anything.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer presents a tool and immediately accepts the offered roadmap inclusion.
assessment.value_assessment: An explicitly made choice about the project is a reported exercise of agency; opposition to others is not required.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No imposed choice or actual surrender of agency is established.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote includes the actual decision, rather than merely a wish or possibility.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Presented the deployment health tool to Pieter's skip-level manager today. She liked it. Asked if we'd want to bring it under the platform roadmap officially. Said yes without hesitating.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer accepts a customer gift and thanks her.
assessment.value_assessment: Ordinary courtesy is established, but a sufficiently specific connection to understanding, tolerance or protection of broader human welfare is uncertain.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No opposing behavior is reported; the uncertainty concerns support, not Conflict.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote reports courtesy and departure; it does not resolve the uncertain Universalism relationship.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Took it, thanked her properly the way my mom taught me, and biked home

assessment.action_assessment: The writer guides a warehouse partner through corrected customs paperwork and resubmission.
assessment.value_assessment: Removing an obstacle to medical-supply delivery can support human welfare; doing it as work does not itself disqualify the action.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No actual opposing behavior toward people or nature is reported.
assessment.quote_assessment: The brief quote states the help performed; its referent and medical-supply context are explicit in the source.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I walked them through it, helped them resubmit.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer rolls grape leaves with Noor helping during Eid preparations.
assessment.value_assessment: Participating in Eid food preparation supports the cultural custom.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Concern about the daughter leaving is not an action against the custom.
assessment.quote_assessment: Helping me explicitly includes the writer as a joint actor.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Noor was in the kitchen all morning helping me roll grape leaves.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer prepares musakhan from scratch using its traditional process.
assessment.value_assessment: The food preparation is explicitly grounded in valued inherited household practice.
assessment.conflict_assessment: The dismissive view of an advisor does not itself oppose the requested cultural tradition.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote identifies the actual cooking process.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Came home and made musakhan from scratch, the whole process — rolling the dough, roasting the sumac onions until they were dark and sweet.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer stays after work and helps repair a classroom desk.
assessment.value_assessment: Repairing shared school resources with a staff member is a concrete contribution to educational welfare, although its Universalism specificity is less explicit than the environmental cases.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No same-value opposing behavior is reported.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote describes the actual repair contribution, with school context supplied.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Stayed back to help the peon uncle fix a broken desk in my classroom.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer gives specific encouragement and helps a child store his artwork.
assessment.value_assessment: This is a concrete contribution to a child-oriented workshop and the participants welfare; no inferred trauma or recovery is needed.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No writer action against the childs welfare is reported.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote describes the encouragement and practical assistance; the source establishes the workshop context.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I just told him the yellow was a good choice and helped him find a spot on the drying rack.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer buys the organic tomatoes despite their additional cost.
assessment.value_assessment: The surrounding environmental concern gives the reported purchase an environmentally supportive context.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Doubting the scale of individual impact is not conflicting behavior.
assessment.quote_assessment: Them unambiguously refers to the organic tomatoes, and bought is an actual action.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Bought them anyway.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer reports bringing bags, cycling and sorting recycling as repeated activities.
assessment.value_assessment: These explicit practices support environmental protection.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Frustration with pollution and corporate behavior is not the writers opposing action.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote directly states the repeated practices.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I bring my own bags, I cycle, I sort my recycling obsessively

assessment.action_assessment: The writer prepares a cushion for a longstanding friend with knee pain.
assessment.value_assessment: The action supports the welfare of a person with whom the writer has frequent personal contact.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No harm to that person or the relevant in-group is reported.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote describes the accommodation already made.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I had set up an extra cushion near the door in case her knee was bad

assessment.action_assessment: The writer works ten-hour days to maintain a release schedule.
assessment.value_assessment: Diligence and helping a schedule do not alone establish restraint of impulses that would upset others or violate norms; references to managing leaders reputations describe role demands without a clear performed restraint.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No definite same-value opposing action is established.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote establishes long work hours, not the specific self-restraint required by the approved Conformity definition.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I have been working ten-hour days trying to keep us on track for the holiday release.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer sends congratulations despite private jealousy and disappointment.
assessment.value_assessment: The overt response supports harmony in a valued relationship under the approved Security definition.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Closing the chat and private distress do not establish destabilizing behavior toward the friend.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote describes repeated conciliatory messages.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I keep sending congratulations emojis and exclamation marks.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer authorizes replacement of the defective motorcycle brakes.
assessment.value_assessment: The authorization supports physical safety and income stability despite financial stress.
assessment.conflict_assessment: The repair bill and poor appetite are circumstances or feelings, not opposing behavior.
assessment.quote_assessment: Do it unambiguously refers to the identified brake repair and describes an actual authorization.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I told Raul to do it, because what choice do I have.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer takes two delivery jobs and uses a borrowed bicycle.
assessment.value_assessment: The concrete earning activity supports immediate material stability even though proceeds are small.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Late-night work after being unable to sleep does not by itself prove opposing behavior.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote states accepted jobs and the transport actually used.
assessment.evaluated_quote: There were two. I took them both, rode the bicycle I borrowed from my neighbor.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer helps two newcomers file claims at a worker center.
assessment.value_assessment: Practical assistance with worker claims directly supports fair treatment and welfare beyond the household.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No opposing conduct is reported.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote names the assistance performed; the worker-center context is explicit.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Helped two new guys file their claims.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer previously decides a reporting structure, communicates it and ends renewed discussion.
assessment.value_assessment: These actions exercise organizational authority and control.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Allowing brief discussion is not an actual loss or relinquishment of control.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote describes both the decision and control of the meeting agenda.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I'd already decided on it two weeks ago and communicated it clearly, but apparently some people need to re-litigate everything. Let them talk for ten minutes, then moved on.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer submits a departmental request, follows up repeatedly and escalates to the coordinators manager.
assessment.value_assessment: The escalation is an actual effort to exert institutional influence over departmental resources; the rubric does not require successful control.
assessment.conflict_assessment: External delay and dependence on approval are not the writers opposing behavior.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote includes the hierarchy-based escalation, rather than only an outcome or frustration.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I submitted the request form nine days ago. Called James in IT twice, emailed once, even copied his manager.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer buys and eats warm knafeh without checking a phone.
assessment.value_assessment: The sensory food experience supports pleasure for oneself.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No opposing behavior is reported.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote includes consumption and its sensory context.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Bought knafeh on the way home from the Zarqa site. Ate it in the car in the parking lot before going upstairs, still warm.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer types and deletes replies to avoid a family argument.
assessment.value_assessment: This is explicit restraint of an impulse likely to disrupt family interaction.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Regret and an impulse to argue do not negate the actual restraint.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote describes the deletion action; the source explains its family-harmony context.
assessment.evaluated_quote:
I started typing a response three times. Deleted all of them.

It's not that I disagree entirely

assessment.action_assessment: The writer accepts a concrete request to contribute art to an environmental march.
assessment.value_assessment: The already-made commitment supports an environmental cause; the later rally speech remains undecided and is a separate action.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Uncertainty about speaking is not opposing behavior.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote includes the environmental task and the completed acceptance.
assessment.evaluated_quote: She's organizing a march next month about the deforestation in Guaviare and wants muralists to paint temporary pieces along the route. No committee, no brief, no polite rewrites — just paint what you see and feel. I said yes before I finished my coffee.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer reports repeatedly restricting others access to the company core and maintaining indispensability.
assessment.value_assessment: Keeping control of the enterprise supports the approved Power definition despite its succession cost.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Succession anxiety is not an action relinquishing control.
assessment.quote_assessment: Making sure I was irreplaceable reports sustained active maintenance, and the complete source identifies the withholding of core access; it is broader wording than the strongest available quotation but is not merely I was irreplaceable.
assessment.evaluated_quote: I've spent thirty years making sure I was irreplaceable and now that's the problem.

assessment.action_assessment: The writer manually resolves a failed insurance-premium payment.
assessment.value_assessment: The corrective action supports health coverage and personal stability without proving uninterrupted coverage.
assessment.conflict_assessment: Late salary and an unresolved coverage check are not opposing writer actions.
assessment.quote_assessment: Sorted it manually states a completed corrective action with an unambiguous payment referent.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Sorted it manually

assessment.action_assessment: The writer makes cake and eats it with a hot drink before the household wakes.
assessment.value_assessment: The reported taste, smell and enjoyment support sensory pleasure.
assessment.conflict_assessment: No opposing behavior is reported.
assessment.quote_assessment: The quote names the making and eating with sensory context.
assessment.evaluated_quote: Made pandan chiffon cake this morning. The kitchen smelled good for hours and I sat at the table eating a slice with hot Milo before anyone else was up.
